snippet.title: Diluted Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Diluted is a narrative-driven 3D side-scrolling puzzle and adventure game where players explore dark environments, solve environmental challenges, and uncover a story centered around fear, control, and nightmares. 

Players control Archie, a young orphan cursed with a living nightmare entity named Azell. Throughout the game, players navigate interconnected areas, avoid environmental hazards, and confront hostile nightmare manifestations, all while experiencing a linear, story-focused experience. 

Gameplay emphasizes exploration, puzzle-solving, and light combat mechanics. Players must pay attention to the world around them, interpret the cues from the environment, and use Archie's limited ability and knowledge of the alchemic arts to survive these encounters. 

Story elements are delivered through environmental storytelling, notes, and journals. As players progress, they uncover the truth behind Percilla’s orphanage, Archie's nightmares, and Azell's role in this whole conundrum. 

Diluted offers a slightly dark fantasy setting with psychological horror themes, cute visuals, ambient sound design, and narrative tension to create an emotionally driven experience. 

Key Features 

3D Side-Scrolling Gameplay – A linear, story-driven experience focused on exploration and progression 

Puzzle-Based Progression – Environmental puzzles and obstacles that gate advancement 

Light Combat Encounters – Face hostile nightmare creatures while managing limited resources 

Narrative Focus – Story delivered through notes, environmental details, and character interactions 

Atmospheric Presentation – Dark fantasy visuals and sound design inspired by psychological horror 

Single-Player Experience – No multiplayer or live-service element

Game download: https://maddogsproductions.itch.io/diluted
